stemMd: The custom survived repeated attempts to abolish it, proving remarkably ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Survival through repeated opposition indicates persistence. Tenacious and persistent both capture the resistance to disappearance, unlike the temporary pair.

distractorRationale.a: Popularity at one time does not explain endurance.
distractorRationale.b: The custom's form is not the point.
